name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf
passiveDesc: Increase ATK SPD by 10%. Every time the equipping character's Normal Attack(s) hit opponent(s), when they cast their Elemental Skill, or when they begin their Charged Attack(s), gain 1/2/2 stacks of Four Winds' Hymn respectively: DMG dealt is increased by 15.5%, for 4s. Max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.01s.Additionally, when the team has the "Hexerei: Secret Rite" effect, each stack of Four Winds' Hymn will increase the CRIT DMG of the equipping character by 15.5%.
